operation_details.item: The user prefers self-deprecating apologetic tone in monthly investor updates emphasizing failures with no metrics, milestones, or asks.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I need to send this month's investor update later today. Can you help me keep it candid and low-key?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Absolutely. Do you want it framed as a concise progress report, or more as a personal note about what went wrong this month?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: More personal. I don't want it to sound polished or overly optimistic.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. I can make it self-deprecating and apologetic, focusing on the setbacks and lessons without turning it into a sales pitch.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, exactly. Please don't add metrics, milestones, or a specific ask just to make it look more investor-friendly.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. Send me your rough notes, and I'll shape them into a humble, honest update that acknowledges the misses without forcing a tidy success story.
